dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Xianyun! We meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Be sure that you do not scare yonder pigeons away. One has awaited them here for quite some time. Failure is not an option...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, do you also want to have some grilled fowl?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A preposterous notion! One has never taken an innocent life, nor shall one start. It is a photo-taking opportunity that one seeks here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry! Paimon was overthinking things there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me give you a hand!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Sure. Your abilities are most worthy of confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Do bear in mind that you must catch both the giant fan blade mechanism and the pigeons on the bridge in the frame. Hardly a challenge to you, one trusts.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Now then, what pose should one strike this time?

choices.text: One that could dazzle anyone who sees it!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: How about... this, then? Are the fan blade mechanisms and pigeons within the frame?

choices.text: I think it looks great. Ready? I'm taking the picture—

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Go ahead, then.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Done, then? Let one peruse the results... Hmm. Well done, as always!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, where have you visited recently?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Not long ago, one followed your guide to Windrise. Fields verdant and lush, a giant tree surrounded by the winds of wisdom — truly a blessed place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, we wrote all about the spots that we've been to that we thought were awesome. Windrise is a great place for a nap too, since it's nice and cool!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: As for the rest, they have been captured on Kamera. Here, have a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon see, let Paimon see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets the concept, but... Why's this Windwheel Aster so huge?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh — that we call a "close-up."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And what's with this super blurry picture?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: An artistic conception, of one's masterful making.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, okay... Anything else?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One has also sampled the delicacies of Mondstadt City.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, now this one looks great! The deliciousness is just oozing out of the picture!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And this is a bird's eye view.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whooooa! How did you even manage to take this picture!?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmph. One needs only to fly into the clouds, of course. A trivial matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it really is a "bird's eye" view...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like you got a lot out of this trip, and enjoyed your time here!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Indeed. A foreign land though this was, your guidebook ensured the smoothness of my travels, with many a pleasant surprise.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Now then, one still has a leisurely stroll through the wilds planned while daylight yet lingers. Do not fret, one has your text on hand yet.

choices.text: Let's go with the pose that blends in better with the local feel.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One has observed the soldiers outside the city doing thusly...

choices.text: I think it looks great. Ready? I'm taking the picture—
Let's go with that super-stunning pose instead.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Surely you jest. One displays stunning majesty at all times! Regardless... Will this suffice?

choices.text: I think it looks great. Ready? I'm taking the picture—
Let's go with the pose that blends in better with the local feel.
One that might blend in with the local ambiance, perhaps?
